import sys
from collections import defaultdict


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split(b"\n")
    sums = defaultdict(float)
    for line in data[1:]:
        p = line.split(b",")
        if len(p) < 3:
            continue
        sums[p[1]] += float(p[2])
    out = [c.decode() + "," + ("%.2f" % sums[c]) for c in sorted(sums)]
    if out:
        sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out) + "\n")


main()
why: Cut per-line overhead: empty lines are already filtered by the len check (b'' splits to 1 field), and defaultdict avoids the get call. Same output format and so
